name: Indian Poker
summary: A one-card poker variant where you see everyone else's card but not your own, played on your forehead.
rules_text: Use a standard 52-card deck. Deal one card face down to each player. On a signal, all players lift their card to their forehead without looking at it, so each player sees all other cards but not his own. Optional rule ranks suits Spades high, then Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs. Conduct one round of betting in turn order: players may check, bet, call, raise or fold based on what they see and opponents' actions. After betting, all remaining players reveal their own cards. Highest rank wins the pot. If suits are ranked, break ties by suit. If only one player remains after folds, they win.
